questions.question: At which ground did Nicolien Janse van Rensburg record their career-best innings (60, List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Wanderers, against Lions on 2024/10/19.

questions.question: Which of these unions has Gezelle Jansen van Rensburg actually played for?
questions.explanation: Gezelle Jansen van Rensburg has represented: Dragons, Eastern Storm, Heat, Knights.

questions.question: South Africa Women won the Women's World Cup Qualifier the very first time they entered it. In what year?
questions.explanation: South Africa won the Women's World Cup Qualifier in 2008, their first appearance in the event.

questions.question: At which ground did Dolphins record their 'Highest Total' (List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Polokwane Oval — highest total of 369, against Limpopo Lillies on 2017/11/11.

questions.question: In head-to-head T20 meetings, who has the edge, Limpopo Lillies or Tuskers?
Who holds the record for 'Highest Individual Score' in the 09/10 season (combined T20 + List A)?
questions.explanation: Susan Benade holds it, with a total of 134.
